text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A new rival steps up for the Takarazuka 
Kinen. This year's Classic Double Crown 
Umamusume, Neo Universe, has announced her 
entry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under immense pressure, Hishi Miracle 
collapses. The Trainer makes the brave 
decision to let her take a break from 
training for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lying in bed, Hishi Miracle realizes 
something. What had always made up for her 
own lack of resolve was the unwavering 
resolve of her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to take the Trainer's bet, Hishi 
Miracle took a proper rest and got right 
back on her feet.
